At the start and end of your turn, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP, gain [blue]{MotivationGain}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], triggers an additional time on the first turn of the next combat.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_BOUNTY.title: Royal Bounty
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_BOUNTY.descripti: At the end of combat, randomly distribute [gold]Gold[/gold] to ALL players equal to [blue]{BountyRate}%[/blue] of the total Max HP of all killed enemies.
